changeinfo.changes:
• Premium Wrapping Swimsuit Set Service Available Now.
  • Fixed various bugs.

• Added the new "Photo Paradise" Mode.
  • Added the ability to play films from the middle in OWNER PARADISE.
  • Added the ability to restore a girl's mood in PHOTO PARADISE.
  • Adjusted the number of swimsuits randomly displayed in the Owner Shop.
  • Fixed various bugs.

• Added the new "Photo Paradise" mode to the Owner's Paradise.
  • Added the new "pose cards" item for the "Photo Paradise" mode.
  • Adjusted the "Pay Attention" function for the "Photo Paradise" mode.
  • Added the new "pose cards" tab in the "Sportswear Shop" for the "Photo Paradise" mode.
  • Adjusted the order for the "Sundries" tab in the Owner's Paradise for the "Photo Paradise" mode.
  • Updated the save file format for the "Photo Paradise" mode.
  • Added the "Lip Sync" function to the Photo Paradise, Pictorial and Gift screens.
  • Added new unlockables.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the rewards for the Owner Results to decrease depending on the evaluation received.
  • Fixed various bugs.

Following features are added.
  • Added the sort function to the Belongings Screen.
  • Added a loop function when turning pages in the Belongings screen and Closet screen.
  • Adjusted the icons and arrangement in Zach's manual.
  • Added the storage function for the DLC swimsuits in the closet.
  • Hold the right stick at the Belongings Screen and the Closet Screen to adjust the change page speed.
  • Fixed other minor bugs.

Following features are added.
  • Added new items that provide the "Attention Getter" feature.
  • New swimsuits can now be downloaded via the catalog (DLC).
  • Fixed an issue that caused an application error when the amount of installed DLC increased.
  • Fixed an issue which caused some of the subtitles to not display during Hitomi's ending scene.
  • Pages can be turned repeatedly by holding down the right stick on the Belongings screen and in the closet.
  • Fixed other minor bugs.

Following features are added.
  • Added new skincare items that provide the ability to "soften" the girls' skin.
  • Added a new "Premium Wrapping" function.
  • Updated the save data format in accordance with newly added game features.
  • Added a new "etc." item category to the Sports Shop and made adjustments to the item categories.
  • Increased the maximum owner level to 110.
  • Added new missions.
  • Fixed other minor bugs.

Following features are added.
  • Other bug fixes.

Following features are added.
  • Fixed an issue that could cause the application to crash under a specific condition after using the Time-Stopping Hourglass.
  • Other bug fixes.

Following features are added.
  • A special bonus that is based on whether girls accepted presents or not will now be added when the Owner Level increases.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when gifts were accepted.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when playing Beach Volleyball.
  • Other bug fixes.

Following features are added.
  • Added an Information Banner display to the pool at the hotel.
  • Added a "Special" section to the Owner Shop that features limited time items.
  • Added icons to denote which items does the girl you are currently controlling "Like" when viewing the Belongings screen.
  • The girl-specific swinsuits icon will be displayed at both the Shop screen and the the Belongings screen.
  • Sunscreen and Suntan Lotion given as gifts to the girl you are currently controling will not be immediately used but remain in the Belongings screen.
  • The bonus Zack Dollars awarded during the Vacation Result screen will increase along with your Owner Level.
  • Other bug fixes.

Following features are added.
  • Fixed and issue which would corrupt save data.
  • Other bug fixes.

Following features are added.
  • Added the "PICTORIAL PARADISE", "EVENT PARADISE", and "RANDOM PLAY" functions.
  • Added the "Excitement Level" to the Character Select and Owner Results screens.
  • Added the ability to put a girl to bed at the hotel and advance to the next morning in Owner Mode as well.
  • The Silver Fan can now be used in any scene in which a girl is present during the game.
  • Added a warning message for connection errors while at the Owner Shop.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when switching between screens in the shop.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when transitioning to the pool.
  • Fixed other minor bugs.
